blocks.text: Two big names in Indonesian music finally meet in one song. Together with Nagaswara, Pop Melayu band Wali teams up with dangdut-pop singer Siti Badriah on their newest single, “Kangen Awakmu”, a song about missing a loved one when distance and circumstance keep you apart. For more than two decades, Wali has been known as one of Indonesia’s most influential Pop Melayu bands, with songs about love and everyday life that are simple, easy to sing along to, and close to listeners across generations, from “Baik-Baik Sayang” and “Cari Jodoh” to “Yank”.
